message_body.subject: Quick question on subprocess hangs & silent agent loop deadlocks
message_body.body:
Hi Team,

Noticed the recurring production failure mode where background agent subprocesses (or async tool calls) stall silently without exit codes, leaving primary agent loops hanging while accumulating token spend.

We built a 15-Point Black-Box Multi-Agent Safety Audit (€99, 24h SLA) that inspects:
- Monotonic wall-clock timeout bounds (circuit breakers)
- Subprocess PID liveness & stale lock reclamation
- Generation-fenced locking to prevent race-condition deadlocks

Key advantage: Zero-Access Security. You don't need to share any repository access, API keys, or private prompts—we analyze only sanitized error schemas, exit traces, or loop configs. Includes 3 concrete drop-in Python mitigation recipes.

Would you be open to a 24-hour audit of one agent workflow for €99 fixed? If so, reply 'AUDIT' and we'll send the 1-page intake checklist.
